# Branch — NAME

**Branch kind: MAIN | SIDE.**
- *main* — works directly toward the goals in [[Main branch]].
- *side* — exploratory, robustness-testing, or scoping; does **not** directly advance those goals.

> [!info] Why this note exists
> Per [[Side branch]], **only a branch index links back to [[Main branch]]**. Individual run and
> experiment notes link here instead. That is what stops exploratory work drifting into the main
> line uncontrolled, and keeps graph view and the document canvases readable.
